fullPassage: Economists like teaching about taxes and subsidies because they don't "stick" where they "land". Some of a tax's burden or a subsidy's benefit passes from those who write or cash the check to other market participants because taxes and subsidies change people's behavior. Buyers might bear the brunt of a tax legally paid by sellers and vice versa. Who is legally responsible for writing the check doesn't matter. How suppliers and demanders respond to changing prices does. Cigarette buyers tend to be less price-sensitive than sellers. When large tobacco companies get taxed, the cigarette supply shrinks. Smokers pay higher prices, but most don't cut back much because they aren't especially price-sensitive. Cigarette taxes land on huge corporations with a great amount of cash but stick to disproportionately poor smokers.

❌ ③ stick — organizers — bear: 'organizers(주최자)'는 시장 맥락에 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ stick — participants — avoid: '피하다'는 타격을 받는다는 원문과 반대.

det.analysis:

❌ ③ responsible: 법적 '책임' — 적절.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 land가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 내려앉다, 부과되다 — (B) 착륙시키다: (A)에서 land는 '세금이 내려앉다(부과되다)'의 비유, (B)에서 land는 비행기를 '착륙시키다'.
❌ ① (A) 땅 — (B) 착륙시키다: (A)에서 land는 동사이지 명사가 아님.
❌ ② (A) 소유하다 — (B) 도착하다: '소유하다'는 land의 의미가 아님.
❌ ④ (A) 떨어지다 — (B) 머무르다: (B)는 '머무르다'가 아니라 '착륙시키다'.
det.tip: land — 동사: 착륙하다/내려앉다 (물리적), 부과되다 (비유적) / 명사: 땅.

❌ ④ profit: '수익'은 기업이 벌어들이는 돈.
det.tip: subsidy(보조금) = grant, aid, funding. 세금(tax)과 함께 정부의 주요 시장 개입 수단.

questions.passage: Buyers might bear the brunt of a tax legally paid by sellers and vice versa. The __________ (responsible) of writing the check doesn't truly determine who pays.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (1단어) (영어로))

det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 관사 The가 있고 뒤에 of가 이어지므로 명사가 필요. responsible(형용사) → responsibility(명사). 'The responsibility of writing the check' = 수표 작성의 책임.
det.tip: responsible(형용사) → responsibility(명사: 책임) → responsibly(부사).

questions.passage: Economists like teaching about taxes and subsidies because they don't "stick" where they "land". When large tobacco companies get taxed, the cigarette supply __________ (shrink). Cigarette taxes land on huge corporations with a great amount of cash but stick to disproportionately poor smokers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (1단어) (영어로))

det.analysis: 주어 the cigarette supply(3인칭 단수)에 맞춰 shrinks. 세금 부과 → 공급 감소.
det.tip: shrink(줄어들다) = decrease, contract. 과세 → 공급 감소.

questions.passage: Economists like teaching about taxes and subsidies because they don't "stick" where they "land". Some of a tax's burden or a subsidy's benefit passes from those who write or cash the check to other market participants because taxes and subsidies ____. Buyers might bear the brunt of a tax legally paid by sellers and vice versa. Who is legally responsible for writing the check doesn't matter. How suppliers and demanders respond to changing prices does. Cigarette buyers tend to be less price-sensitive than sellers. When large tobacco companies get taxed, the cigarette supply shrinks. Smokers pay higher prices, but most don't cut back much because they aren't especially price-sensitive. Cigarette taxes land on huge corporations with a great amount of cash but stick to disproportionately poor smokers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① change people's behavior: 세금과 보조금이 '사람들의 행동을 변화시키기' 때문에 부담이 전가된다는 원문 그대로.
❌ ② lower production costs: '생산 비용 절감'은 원문의 핵심이 아님.
❌ ③ increase government revenue: '정부 수입 증가'는 결과이지 행동 변화의 원인이 아님.
❌ ④ protect consumer rights: '소비자 권리 보호'는 본문과 다른 방향.
det.tip: change people's behavior = 사람들의 행동을 변화시키다. 세금의 경제적 효과의 핵심.

questions.passage: Economists like teaching about taxes and subsidies because they don't "stick" where they "land". Some of a tax's burden or a subsidy's benefit passes from those who write or cash the check to other market participants because taxes and subsidies change people's behavior. Buyers might bear the brunt of a tax legally paid by sellers and vice versa. Who is legally responsible for writing the check doesn't matter. How suppliers and demanders respond to changing prices does. Cigarette buyers tend to be less ____ than sellers. When large tobacco companies get taxed, the cigarette supply shrinks. Smokers pay higher prices, but most don't cut back much because they aren't especially price-sensitive. Cigarette taxes land on huge corporations with a great amount of cash but stick to disproportionately poor smokers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ price-sensitive: 뒤 문장 'most don't cut back much because they aren't especially price-sensitive'로 확인. 흡연자가 가격에 '덜 민감하다'는 핵심.
❌ ① well-informed: '정보에 밝은'은 가격 반응과 다른 차원.
❌ ② health-conscious: '건강을 의식하는'은 흡연자가 담배를 계속 사는 이유는 될 수 있지만 가격 반응과 직접 관련 없음.
❌ ③ brand-loyal: '브랜드 충성도'는 가격 민감도와 다름.
det.tip: price-sensitive(가격에 민감한) — 가격 변화에 따라 구매를 조절하는 성향. 흡연자는 중독성 때문에 가격 변화에 덜 민감.
